email.subject: Fast Lane Group Auto Care - quick site fix
email.body:
Hi Grace,

I checked your site and noticed there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors looking for a quick quote or tow have to copy your number manually before calling - that's likely costing you calls from people who'd rather just tap and dial. The site also doesn't list your hours anywhere, which means people checking if you're open right now may just move on to a competitor instead.

I fix issues like these for local businesses for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
